headline: Mészáros Lőrinc's company excluded; Opus Titász gets nothing from the RRF money brought home
summary: A company linked to Lőrinc Mészáros was excluded from RRF funding because it failed to meet transparency requirements. Opus Titász also received nothing from the funds brought home.
why: EU Recovery and Resilience Facility funds are allocated to Hungarian projects and companies under strict transparency and eligibility conditions.

original_headline: Kizárták Mészáros Lőrinc cégét, az Opus Titász nem kap semmit a hazahozott RRF-pénzekből
